title: Visual frame
slide_intent: Teach how to group many partner logos while preserving their individual forms. A shared boundary helps readers see the relationship among otherwise different marks.
strategic_value: A frame derived from the Frontline AIDS symbol can identify the network as a whole while giving its members room to appear in their own colors and lettering.
demonstration: The explanation at left describes a scalable holding device. At right a black outline extends from the Frontline AIDS identity around a four-column array of partner logos.
practical_value: Use the broad network frame for the full partnership and size a smaller version around the participating organizations on a project.

content_islands.name: Heading and guidance
content_islands.spec: Place Visual frame and two paragraphs in the open left column beside the partnerships navigation.

content_islands.name: Network lockup
content_islands.spec: Attach the black Frontline AIDS signature at the upper left of a rectangular outline. Space the partner marks into rows and columns within it.
